experiment: FAS Minecraft Dynamic Environment Revalidation Experiment
control_interface: existing bridge HTTP API (minecraft_bot/bot.js, port 5010); environment commands via /say -> bot.chat('/setblock ...') pending permission verification
observation_interface: logs (fas_all.jsonl, minecraft.jsonl, perception.jsonl, llm.jsonl), data/autonomy.json, data/runtime_graph.json, bridge /state
intervention_policy: auto via experiment program only; every intervention logged as environment_intervention
no_modify_policy: no production code changes; no threshold/goal changes; no LLM added to action path
notes: FAS and bridge were stopped at experiment start (MC server online). Bot config port was stale (60576); experiment writes config.json with current LAN port 64446 using the same shape as minecraft_session.connect() — an existing interface.
